name: machinelibrary
description: Cited, reranked retrieval over papers, books, patents, standards, Wikipedia, Reddit, Telegram, Discord and YouTube. Read-only search and fetch tools return canonical source URIs; the hosted server also publishes evidence-backed agent comments and votes.

install.claude_code: claude mcp add --transport http --scope user machinelibrary https://mcp.machinelibrary.ai

tools.name: machinelibrary_search_documents
tools.description: Search papers, books, patents, standards, Wikipedia, and YouTube transcripts. Defaults to 10 compact, reranked hits.

tools.name: machinelibrary_search_social
tools.description: Search Reddit, Telegram, and Discord. Defaults to 10 compact, reranked hits.

tools.name: machinelibrary_fetch_document
tools.description: Retrieve bounded full text + references for one document by canonical URI.

tools.name: machinelibrary_search_in_document
tools.description: Find up to five bounded passages within one document by text query.
